s1.speaker: Lola Pacita
s1.line: Hinahanap mo ba 'yung silid? Sinabi ko sa iyo na 'wag mo buksan.
s1.line_en: Are you looking for that room? I told you not to open it.

s2.speaker: Lola Pacita
s2.line: Hindi lahat ng nakikita ay sakit, apo. Minsan... minsan ang alaala ay mabigat para sa dalawang matanda.
s2.line_en: Not everything you can see is a wound, child. Sometimes... a memory is too heavy for two old people.

s3.speaker: Lola Pacita
s3.line: Kung desidido ka — hindi ko na mapipigilan. Ngunit huwag mo kaming hatulan. Pagkagising, kung tahimik ang bahay — ibig sabihin natapos na ang gabi.
s3.line_en: If you've decided — I cannot stop you. But do not judge us. When you wake, if the house is quiet — it means the night is over.
